messages:
rachel: Quick check-in on 'elastic-shelf' reservations for Dedicated — customers asked for a small, guaranteed surge shelf with clear preempt rules and predictable billing.

dan: Define shelf: x% of baseline capacity reserved as short-lived buffer (default 100% baseline, shelf=50%), protected for N seconds.

marta: Ops: need pulse shape (arrival curve). metrics-bot can tag pilot tenants and emit 95/99th burst profiles?

metrics-bot: Job `shelf_burst_profile_v1` created for tenants tagged `shelf-pilot`. Daily digest -> #eng-runtime.

keith: Billing stance: ship GA behavior-first, docs declare billing_mode but enforcement off. Sales asked for clear default; default = reserved-rate for spilled.

rachel: Proto sketch to align runtime + ops:

```
elastic_shelf {
  baseline_rps: 120
  shelf_fraction: 0.5
  protect_window_s: 30
  preempt_priority: ["dedicated","shelf","hosted"]
  billing_mode: "reserved_rate"
}
```

marta: Launch checklist: feature flag, unit/integration tests for preempt ordering, APAC canary with 3 pilots for 10 days, dashboards for spill_count/cost/evictions, runbook with manual shelf-extend and TTL override.

dan: I'll own canary and synthetic load harness. keith will own billing docs and soft-cap for pilots. rachel will finalize SLA wording.

rachel: I'll book 30m sign-off Fri. If no objections by EOD scope locked. :thumbsup:
